description.en: SenseNova Token Plan OpenAI-compatible API with account model discovery and Coding Plan quota polling.
description.zh: 商汤日日新 Token Plan OpenAI 兼容 API，支持账号模型发现与 Coding Plan 按模型额度查询。

description.en: Add an inference API key and optionally a console access token for Coding Plan quota refresh.
description.zh: 填写推理 API Key，并可选填写控制台访问令牌以刷新 Coding Plan 额度。

help_text.en: Optional. Paste the console Bearer JWT to refresh per-model Coding Plan quota. It is short-lived and must be replaced after expiry.
help_text.zh: 可选。粘贴控制台 Bearer JWT 以刷新各模型 Coding Plan 额度；令牌会过期，过期后需重新填写。

help_text.en: Optional. Normally extracted from the console token; fill it only if automatic extraction fails.
help_text.zh: 可选。通常会从控制台令牌自动提取；仅在自动提取失败时填写。

title.zh: 连接商汤日日新 Coding Plan
